create.name: Lama Rod Owens
create.bio:
Lama Rod Owens is a Tibetan Buddhist teacher, authorised as a lama in the Kagyu lineage, a yoga teacher and an author whose teaching joins Buddhist practice with personal and social liberation. He holds a Master of Divinity in Buddhist studies from Harvard Divinity School, where his focus was the meeting point of identity, social change and spiritual life. In 2018 he co-founded Bhumisparsha, a community set up to make tantric practice open and inclusive for practitioners in North America. He calls himself, with typical humour, a Black Buddhist Southern queen, and lets his Southern roots shape the way he teaches.

His books are Radical Dharma, written with others, Love and Rage, on working with anger as a path to freedom, and The New Saints, which invites readers to become everyday spiritual warriors. Much of his teaching draws on Tibetan deity practice: he guides practices of Tara, Chenrezig and other figures, offers self-paced courses such as one on the Heart Sutra and what he calls spiritual abolition, and hosts Free Radicals, a free monthly online gathering first set up for friends in the UK. He also leads daylong retreats in person, has taught at Kripalu, and speaks at universities and organisations; his manner is warm, frank and often funny, aimed at meeting people where they are.

books.title: The New Saints: From Broken Hearts to Spiritual Warriors
books.author: Lama Rod Owens
books.description: His newest book, mixing personal stories, traditional teachings and contemplative and body-based practices, on how ordinary people can become saints and spiritual warriors for their time.

books.title: Love and Rage: The Path of Liberation Through Anger
books.author: Lama Rod Owens
books.description: A Buddhist look at anger: rather than bypassing it, he shows how to meet it honestly, feel it in the body and let it become a source of freedom.

books.title: Radical Dharma: Talking Race, Love, and Liberation
books.author: Rev. angel Kyodo williams, Lama Rod Owens and Jasmine Syedullah
books.description: A three-way conversation between Buddhist teachers and a scholar on how dharma practice and the work of social liberation belong together.

courses.title: The Heart of Ma Tara: A Self-Guided Practice of Liberation & Boundless Compassion
courses.description: A self-paced series of talks, guided rituals and energetic practices invoking Tara, the female Buddha of compassion, with altar-making and reflections on figures who carry her spirit.

courses.title: The Dharma of Spiritual Abolition: Self-Guided Course on the Heart Sutra
courses.description: Recorded talks and guided practice on the Heart Sutra, exploring form and emptiness and how living with contradiction can serve freedom for ourselves and others.

free_resources.title: Free Radicals: A Monthly Online Community Gathering
free_resources.description: A free hour of practice and community online on the first Thursday of each month, timed for the UK but open to all, with captions; donations are welcome but optional.
